title: Step 2b - Multiple Linear Regression in Python: Preparing Your Dataset

cues.zh: 也就是這個階段的 X 究竟是什麼。

cues.en: So, I'm gonna do "print[x]", and I'm going to run the cell.
cues.zh: 寫 print(X)，執行儲存格。

cues.en: All right? And, let's see what we get.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: All right, so indeed, we get exactly the same columns as in this data set, with first "R&D Spend", then "Administration Spend", then "Marketing Spend",
cues.zh: 的確取得和原始資料相同的欄位，依序是 R&D Spend、Administration、Marketing Spend，

cues.en: and "State", right?
cues.zh: 以及 State。

cues.en: We can clearly see that we get the same columns here in the same order, all right?
cues.zh: 欄位與順序都相同。

cues.en: So, that's the matrix of features.
cues.zh: 這就是特徵矩陣。

cues.en: All good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Now, I'm not gonna show you the dependent viable vector, because that's abuse.
cues.zh: 依變數向量就不另外展示，因為很明顯。

cues.en: We're gonna get the same profit.
cues.zh: 會得到相同的 Profit。

cues.en: But, what I wanna show you is what becomes x after we encode the categorical data, you know, and you can actually guess what it will become, but you will see
cues.zh: 但我要展示類別編碼之後，X 會變成什麼。你可以先猜，稍後會看到，

cues.en: that the three columns resulting here from one-hot encoding will actually be placed at the beginning.
cues.zh: 獨熱編碼產生的三欄會被放到最前面。

cues.en: All right? So, let's check it out.
cues.zh: 來確認。

cues.en: Let's run the cell to indeed apply "Encoding categorical data".
cues.zh: 執行類別資料編碼的儲存格。

cues.en: And, now, let's create a new code cell, in which we're gonna "print[x]" again.
cues.zh: 再新增儲存格，重新 print(X)。

cues.en: And, let's run this cell to see what x becomes.
cues.zh: 執行，看看 X 的樣子。

cues.en: And, there you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Exactly as I told you, we have the same three first columns here.
cues.zh: 如前所述，原先三個數值欄位仍保留。

cues.en: So, that corresponds to "R&D Spend", that corresponds to "Administration spend", and that corresponds to "Marketing spend".
cues.zh: 分別是 R&D Spend、Administration 與 Marketing Spend。

cues.en: But, now, instead of having this "State" column here, we indeed have these three new columns at the beginning, encoding that state variable, and we can actually see what corresponds to what.
cues.zh: 但 State 已不再是原本那欄，而是在最前面新增三個編碼欄位，而且可以看出各自對應什麼。

cues.en: You know, if we have a look at our data set.
cues.zh: 看看原始資料。

cues.en: Well, the first row has "New York" as a state, and therefore, "New York" was encoded as zero, zero, and one.
cues.zh: 第一列的州是 New York，所以 New York 編碼為 [0, 0, 1]。

cues.en: Then, let's see, as a second state of the second row, you know, corresponding to the second state, we have "California", and therefore, California was encoded as one, zero, and zero.
cues.zh: 第二列是 California，因此編碼為 [1, 0, 0]。

cues.en: And, finally, well, "Florida" was encoded as zero, one, and zero.
cues.zh: 最後，Florida 編碼為 [0, 1, 0]。

cues.en: All right, so that's the one-hot encoding that happened, and now, all good.
cues.zh: 這就是完成的獨熱編碼，現在都準備好了。

cues.en: We have a fully pre-processed data set.
cues.zh: 資料集已完成前處理。

cues.en: And, as I told you in part one, but I'm gonna say it again here, because this is important, we don't have to apply feature scaling.
cues.zh: 第一部分說過，現在再提醒，這裡不需要特徵縮放。

cues.en: Why? Because you know, in the equation of the Multiple Linear Regression, you know, you have this coefficient that is multiplied to each independent variable, you know, each feature.
cues.zh: 因為多元線性迴歸的方程式中，每個自變數、每個特徵都會乘上一個係數。

cues.en: And, therefore, it doesn't matter that some features have higher values than others, because the coefficients will compensate to put everything on the same scale.
cues.zh: 即使某些特徵數值較大，係數也能補償，讓各項影響取得適當尺度。

cues.en: And, therefore, remember this, in Multiple Linear Regression, there is absolutely no need to apply feature scaling.
cues.zh: 所以請記住，這裡的多元線性迴歸不需要特徵縮放。

cues.en: And, one last thing I would like to add, as well, because I know a lot of you asked this question.
cues.zh: 最後補充一點，因為很多人會問。

cues.en: Do we need to check the assumptions of linear regression?
cues.zh: 要檢查線性迴歸假設嗎？

cues.en: The answer is absolutely not, because I will explain at the end of this part, you know, part two regression, that whenever you have a new data set, and you want to experiment with
cues.zh: 這裡講者認為不需要，因為第二部分迴歸的結尾會介紹，拿到新資料集、想測試

cues.en: some machinery models to figure out which one leads to the highest accuracy, well, even if your data set doesn't have linear relationships, you can still try
cues.zh: 多種模型並找出準確度最高者時，即使資料沒有線性關係，也仍可以

cues.en: a Multiple Linear Regression on it.
cues.zh: 先試多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: And, if you know your data set doesn't have linear relationships, well, your Multiple Linear Regression model will just perform poorly, and therefore, it will get an accuracy lower
cues.zh: 如果資料沒有線性關係，多元線性迴歸可能表現差，準確度就會低於

cues.en: than the accuracies of your other models.
cues.zh: 其他模型。

cues.en: So, you will just not select the Multiple Linear Regression model, but you don't have to check the Multiple Linear Regression assumptions.
cues.zh: 因此，最後不選它即可，在這種比較流程中不必先檢查多元線性迴歸假設。

cues.en: It will just be a waste of time.
cues.zh: 講者認為那樣會浪費時間。

cues.en: Really, I will show you at the end how you can so fast and so efficiently try each of the models on your dataset and select very quickly the one that has the highest accuracy.
cues.zh: 最後會示範如何快速、有效地測試各模型，再選準確度最高的。

cues.en: All right, so, I just wanted to be clear on that point.
cues.zh: 只是想把這一點說清楚。

cues.en: Don't worry about the Multiple Linear Regression assumptions.
cues.zh: 在這裡先不用擔心多元線性迴歸假設。

cues.en: If your data set has linear relationships, then good, your Multiple Linear Regression will check the assumptions indeed and will bring to you a high accuracy.
cues.zh: 若資料有適當線性關係，模型就能符合需求，帶來好的準確度。

cues.en: And, if your data set doesn't have linear relationships, well fine, your Multiple Linear Regression just will perform poorly, and you will just take another model.
cues.zh: 如果沒有，模型表現就差，換另一個模型。

cues.en: And, that's it.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's as simple as that.
cues.zh: 很簡單。

cues.en: All right, so, now, good, we're done with data pre-processing.
cues.zh: 現在資料前處理完成。

cues.en: We can, therefore, move on to the next step, which is to train the Multiple Linear Regression model on the training set.
cues.zh: 可以進入下一步，在訓練集上訓練多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: So, take a little break here, and as soon as you're ready to build your next machinery model, well, join me in the next tutorial to tackle this.
cues.zh: 先休息一下，準備好建立下一個模型後，到下一堂一起操作。

cues.en: And, until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
